segments.name: Las Vegas Locals
segments.description: Runs casinos and hotels serving local customers in Las Vegas.
segments.evidence: For financial reporting purposes, we aggregate these operations into four reportable segments: (i) Las Vegas Locals; (ii) Downtown Las Vegas; (iii) Midwest & South; and (iv) Online, (collectively "Reportable Segments").

segments.name: Downtown Las Vegas

segments.evidence: For financial reporting purposes, we aggregate these operations into four reportable segments: (i) Las Vegas Locals; (ii) Downtown Las Vegas; (iii) Midwest & South; and (iv) Online, (collectively "Reportable Segments").

segments.name: Midwest & South

segments.name: Online
segments.description: Offers online sports betting and casino games through market access agreements.
segments.evidence: The Online segment includes the operating results of our online gaming operations through market access agreements with third parties throughout the United States and the operations of Boyd Interactive.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay to gamble, stay in its hotels and bet online.
revenueModel.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, we operated 27 gaming entertainment properties offering a total of 1,730,321 square feet of casino space, 27,267 slot machines, 600 table games and 10,146 hotel rooms.
